sub_graphs.title: EIP-5345: Silent Signing Permission Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of silent signing permissions from request through expiration

nodes.label: No Silent Signing Permission
nodes.description: Application has no silent signing permission, must use standard signing methods

nodes.label: Request Silent Signing Permission
nodes.description: Application calls wallet_requestSilentSign to request automatic signing permission

nodes.label: User Consent Prompt Displayed
nodes.description: Wallet displays consent UI to user showing permission scope and duration

nodes.label: User Grants Permission
nodes.description: User approves the silent signing permission request

nodes.label: User Denies Permission
nodes.description: User rejects the silent signing permission request

nodes.label: Silent Signing Permission Active
nodes.description: Permission is active with permissionSecret token valid until expiry timestamp

nodes.label: Permission Request Denied
nodes.description: User denied permission, application remains in standard signing mode

nodes.label: Check Permission Expiry
nodes.description: System checks if current time exceeds permission timestamp

nodes.label: Permission Expired
nodes.description: Permission has expired and is no longer valid

nodes.label: User Revokes Permission
nodes.description: User manually revokes the silent signing permission

nodes.label: Permission Manually Revoked
nodes.description: User has revoked permission before expiry

external_entities.name: Requesting Application
external_entities.description: dApp or application requesting silent signing permission from user's wallet

external_entities.name: Wallet User
external_entities.description: User who controls the wallet and grants/revokes permissions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5345: Silent Transaction Signing and Sending

nodes.label: Permission Secret Invalid

nodes.label: Check Transaction Scope
nodes.description: Verify transaction is within permitted contract and function scope

nodes.description: Transaction targets permitted contract and function

nodes.label: Transaction Out of Scope
nodes.description: Transaction targets unpermitted contract or function

nodes.label: Sign Transaction
nodes.description: Wallet signs transaction without user interaction

nodes.label: Transaction Signed
nodes.description: Transaction has been signed and is ready for broadcast

nodes.description: Broadcast signed transaction to blockchain via sendRawTransaction

nodes.label: Transaction Broadcast to Network

external_entities.name: Decentralized Application

nodes.label: Validate Chain ID

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5345: Trust Boundaries and Security Controls
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundaries and controls in silent signing

nodes.label: Untrusted Application Request
nodes.description: Request received from potentially untrusted application

nodes.label: Display Consent UI to User
nodes.description: Wallet displays full permission scope to user for informed consent

nodes.label: User Informed of Permission Scope
nodes.description: User has been shown the full permission scope including contract, functions, and duration

nodes.label: Generate Permission Secret
nodes.description: Wallet generates cryptographically random permissionSecret token

nodes.label: Secret Stored Securely
nodes.description: Permission secret and scope stored securely in wallet

nodes.label: Enforce Temporal Boundary
nodes.description: System enforces permission expiry based on unix timestamp

nodes.label: Enforce Scope Boundary
nodes.description: System restricts transactions to permitted contract and functions

nodes.label: Security Boundaries Enforced
nodes.description: Both temporal and scope boundaries are actively enforced

external_entities.name: Untrusted Application
external_entities.description: External application that may be malicious or compromised

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define how the permissionSecret should be generated or its minimum entropy requirements
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume permissionSecret must be generated using cryptographically secure random number generator with at least 128 bits of entropy.

ambiguities.text: Function scope restriction via signatures like 'equip(address,uint256)' but no specification for handling overloaded functions
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume permission applies to the 4-byte function selector derived from the signature, so overloaded functions with same name but different parameters are distinguished by their selectors.

ambiguities.text: No clear behavior specified when permission secret is leaked or compromised
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume wallet provides revocation mechanism and user should immediately revoke permission if secret is suspected compromised.

implicit_assumptions.description: User understands the permission scope being granted and makes an informed consent decision
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may grant overly broad permissions without understanding, enabling malicious applications to drain funds or perform unwanted actions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attacker cannot intercept or steal the permissionSecret from the application
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If permissionSecret is stolen, attacker can submit transactions on behalf of user within the granted scope until expiry.

implicit_assumptions.description: The wallet implementation correctly enforces scope restrictions on every transaction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A buggy wallet could allow out-of-scope transactions, enabling unauthorized actions.

implicit_assumptions.description: WalletConnect bridge servers (for mobile) do not tamper with or leak transaction data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Compromised bridge could intercept transactions, leak permission secrets, or inject malicious transactions.
